(2) Gated destination leaves, all applyTo: equalsGate(destinationSameAsConsignee, false, <in-scope decision>, <out-of-scope decision>) per model/obligations/helpers/index.js (exemplars: regionCode status-flip, purposeInInternalMarket purge-on-flip in sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/): destinationName, destinationAddressLine1, destinationCity, destinationPostcode, destinationCountry mandatory-in-scope; destinationAddressLine2, destinationAddressLine3 optional-in-scope (equalsGate whenTrue/whenFalse decisions are caller-supplied, so optional-in-scope is expressible — mirror the live-animals decision-object shapes exactly). (3) Packer leaves, all status 'optional', no gates: packerName, packerAddressLine1, packerAddressLine2, packerAddressLine3, packerCity, packerPostcode, packerCountry. Importer and consignee are NOT obligations (POP-1/POP-3 server/stub-populated — SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1). All names are path-safe camelCase answers keys and DOM field names.
Import + re-export every parties.js obligation by name; append all 15 to the `obligations` array. `groups` stays derived (no new groups). `policy` untouched.

feature('traders', [...]) with one scalar({ field, obligation }) binding per parties.js obligation (15 bindings; all top-level scalars, no groups). Exports `evaluationBindings`.

export const meta = { ...tradersAddressesPage, collects: [all 15 obligation names] }; export const routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }) — kit.pageRoutes builds its route path from the PREFIX-FREE route-shape builder (pageRoutePath) at module load; the `/plant-products` mount is supplied by the gateway's Hapi plugin prefix, never written into the route table. Every href/redirect this controller emits (back link, consignor link, nextTarget) uses the PREFIX-BEARING link builders, resolved per request. GET: state.get() ONCE; prefill from answers; view model via kit.base() with journey (reference strip); back link hubPath(journey.journeyId); importer card data from services/stub-org.js (read-only, POP-1); consignor card: 'Not yet added' state + 'Add a consignor or exporter' link to the consignor-create slug path (page lands with pp-036 — link renders now, dead until then). POST: Joi validation built with factories from src/server/app/lib/validate/index.js — destinationSameAsConsignee required ('Select yes if the delivery address is the same as the importer's address'); when scope.has(destinationName) (i.e. answered false): destinationName required ('Enter the delivery address name'), destinationAddressLine1 required ('Enter address line 1 of the delivery address'), destinationCity required ('Enter the town or city of the delivery address'), destinationPostcode required ('Enter the postcode or ZIP code' — c-010 term), destinationCountry required ('Select the country of the delivery address'), lines 2/3 optional; packer fields all optional (length caps only, reuse the standard validate factories' caps); country values must be members of the pp-013 countries fixture (membership rule built inside POST, never a frozen module-level list). Invalid POST: re-render RAW values, status 400. Valid POST: commit cleaned values via state.commit() — NEVER commit destination leaves when destinationSameAsConsignee is true (out of scope; the evaluator purges on flip); redirect via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope); wrap the write in kit.recoverableSave() (marked failure → re-render recoverableError: true, 500; other errors throw). NO consignor-presence rule in this controller — consignor mandatoriness arrives with pp-036's manifest leaves and rolls up through the traders task row.

Extends shared/layout.njk (unprefixed). Caption 'Traders' (govuk-caption-xl) + H1 (govuk-heading-xl). DELIBERATE deviations from the legacy page (page-spec nonStandardPatterns rulings): (1) NO four-column trader-tables — each populated party renders as a govuk-summary-list; an EMPTY slot renders heading + link/copy only, never an empty table (a11y defect not ported). (2) NO 'Same as consignee' bespoke link-button — the delivery address is govukRadios legend 'Is the delivery address the same as the importer's address?' (legend-as-heading m-size, honest label naming the IMPORTER — fixes the consignee copy defect and the one-shot irreversibility for free), No reveals the destination fields via the radios conditional-reveal pattern: govukInput destinationName / destinationAddressLine1 / destinationAddressLine2 ('(optional)') / destinationAddressLine3 ('(optional)') / destinationCity / destinationPostcode ('Postcode or ZIP code', c-010) + govukSelect destinationCountry from the pp-013 countries fixture options. (3) Importer: H2 + read-only govuk-summary-list of the stub org (name/address/country), NO Change action. (4) Packer: H2 'Packer (optional)' + the seven optional packer inputs (same field layout as destination, packerCountry a govukSelect). (5) Consignor or exporter: H2 + populated summary-list OR 'Add a consignor or exporter' govuk-link (no font-size override — the legacy 19px link modifier is not ported). (6) ONE primary govuk-button Continue + the standard shared save actions (Save and return to hub secondary, Cancel link) per the house kit partials — not the legacy two-equal-primaries. Shared error summary ('There is a problem', c-004); input name = id = error key so #<fieldName> summary links focus controls. GOV.UK macros only, no custom CSS.

acceptanceCriteria: The traders-addresses page renders at /plant-products/notifications/{journeyId}/traders-addresses — served by the plant-products gateway in the same process that serves live-animals under its own /live-animals mount (R7 symmetric mounts — no set owns the root; / is a server-wide 302 to /live-animals) — with caption 'Traders', an H1, and four party areas: Importer (read-only), Packer (optional), Delivery address, Consignor or exporter.

Importer renders as a read-only govuk-summary-list populated from the fixed stub organisation, with no Change/Add affordance (POP-1 pass 1); it is not an obligation and never appears in the answers tree.

The delivery address is asked as radios 'Is the delivery address the same as the importer's address?' (legend references the IMPORTER — the legacy 'Same as consignee' label/copy defect is not ported); the choice is reversible: flipping Yes→No→Yes at any time works and the engine wipes out-of-scope destination values.

Selecting No reveals destination name, address lines 1–3 (2 and 3 optional), town or city, 'Postcode or ZIP code' (c-010), and a country select sourced from the pp-013 countries fixture stored by code; all five mandatory fields validate with one canonical Joi message each (c-018), rendered via the GDS 'There is a problem' summary with working focus links (c-004/c-014).
Submitting with no radio selection shows 'Select yes if the delivery address is the same as the importer's address'; invalid submits re-render raw values with status 400 and commit nothing.
Packer is genuinely optional: the page saves with all packer fields empty; entered packer values persist and round-trip through draft resume; packer never affects task-row completeness.

No empty govuk-table (or any table) renders for an unpopulated party — empty slots show heading + link/copy only (legacy empty-table a11y defect not ported); no bespoke CSS classes (link-button, trader-table, col-*, table-responsive) appear in the template.

The consignor area shows 'Add a consignor or exporter' linking to the consignor-create slug path; this increment does NOT block continue on a missing consignor (enforcement arrives with pp-036's manifest leaves).

The traders flow section and mandatory 'traders' task row exist; the hub shows the Traders row (en + cy copy) linking to the page; row status transitions Not yet started → In progress → Completed are pinned in task-rows.test.js and the row participates in readyForCheckYourAnswers.

notes: 1:1 carry of inc-026 as the spoke-10 opener. RULINGS APPLIED from the traders-addresses page spec: the legacy page's architecture is deliberately NOT ported — (a) mini-hub-inside-a-form with hidden etag → a normal collecting page in the house model (no etag; last-write-wins per Open Q 3); (b) four-column trader-tables with bespoke col-*/trader-table/table-responsive CSS → govuk-summary-list per populated party (the spec's own govukAlternative); (c) empty-slot placeholder tables (screen-reader-meaningless, shown to pass axe while defective) → no table when empty; (d) the 'Same as consignee' link-button (no double-click guard, wrong label — it copies the IMPORTER, one-shot irreversible) → the spec's recommended Radios question naming the importer honestly, which also makes the choice reversible; (e) two equal-weight primary buttons → house single-primary + shared save actions; (f) legacy slot-level messages ('Add a delivery address') → per-field Joi messages, since the destination is now collected in-page rather than via a sub-journey. Mandatoriness grounded in legacy PartOne @NotNull evidence (importer/destination/consignor mandatory, packer optional): importer satisfied by POP-1 auto-population (modelled as derived value, exactly as the spec's requiredEvidence note recommends); destination via the gated leaves; consignor deferred to pp-036 (its 'Add a consignor or exporter' enforcement becomes manifest mandatoriness rolling into the traders row, not a controller rule here). destinationSameAsConsignee has no backend field — projected as destination=importer-copy on save (matching the legacy asserted copy behaviour) and re-derived by equality on load; flagged in openQuestions. Destination/packer email+telephone deliberately omitted in pass 1 (legacy sub-journey optionality unverified; §3.1 does not list them) with mapper omission assertions. EXEMPLARS: sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-section.md + add-a-page.md; transport feature group (multi-page group shape); origin feature (conditional scope + service-backed select); regionCode/purposeInInternalMarket obligations (equalsGate status-flip and purge-on-flip decision shapes, model/obligations/helpers/scalar/equals-gate.js verified live this session). Check-answers rows are NOT this increment's work — features/check-answers is built whole by pp-038, which already depends on pp-035. ORDERING ASSUMPTION: pp-010 (contract.plant-products.test.js, T-5) precedes all m2+ pages per §9 rule 2 even though it is not in this increment's canonical dependsOn.
openQuestions: destinationSameAsConsignee has no backing schema field; pass 1 derives it from destination↔importer address equality at load. A hand-entered destination that happens to equal the importer's address would re-derive as 'Yes' — cosmetically wrong, data-identical. If product cares, add an explicit boolean to the backend DTO (small backend change) — flag at review.

Destination and packer email/telephone are omitted in pass 1 (legacy delivery-address sub-journey collected them but their optionality is unverified; SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1 does not list them for destination/packer). Confirm whether the backend PlantProductsOperator requires them before m4 closes.

PACKER IS COMPLETELY UNMINED in the legacy corpus (zero traces, zero QA coverage) — carried forward as seven flat optional fields per the planningBrief, but the page spec recommends a human confirms CHED-PP needs a packer at all; strong deletion candidate.

Legacy 'Save and return to hub' on this page had zero automated coverage and unknown validation semantics; this increment uses the house shared save-action semantics uniformly. Confirm nothing product-side depended on a validation-bypassing partial save.

The legacy fraud warning ('Providing a false address is an act of fraud') is NOT shown on CHED-PP (template-gated to other CHED types) and is not added here; product may want it on the delivery address — decide with pp-038/design review.

Until pp-036 lands, the 'Add a consignor or exporter' link targets a not-yet-existing consignor-create route (404). Acceptable within the m4 build order (pp-036 directly depends on pp-035); if the increments are demoed separately, hide the link behind a dispatch-index existence check instead.
